groups.data: All712native training images and derived inputs/references with portable paths, hashes and source attribution; no protected evaluation images.
groups.weights: Two final4000step partial StyleGAN2 generator patches; original SAM model required; not automatically activated.
groups.checkpoints: Both arms1000/2000/3000step generator snapshots and trained local discriminator; no optimizer state, not exact restart packages.
groups.baseline: Original SAM, ft_l1, FairFace, YuNet, identity/LPIPS and SFace dependencies; reuse existing releases without duplicate uploads.
groups.evidence: Frozen training/diagnostic code, paired sampling logs, full-data audit, native review decisions, independent metrics and browser validation; no portrait or latent payload.
groups.examples: Source-attributed original/raw75/native-crop comparisons of full native training and optional original SAM displacement diagnostic.
